description: Monthly repair counts cover a Central European town of about 30,000 residents and approximately 24 square kilometres from 2000 to 2016. This resource is provided by Zdenek Vintr. Coverage is city as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Repairs are used as a proxy for failures, including equipment as well as pipe events. Individual event times are unavailable. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
